source_notes: Quote URLs are start pages for new-customer flows; carriers redesign these frequently. The agent MUST re-verify each URL with WebFetch before printing. J.D. Power and NAIC fields are intentionally null — the agent fetches them live so the user gets current numbers, not stale ones.

channels.direct: Buy online or by phone, no agent.

carriers.name: State Farm
carriers.notes: Largest US auto insurer by market share. Agent-driven; rates often best when bundled with home/renters.

carriers.name: Progressive
carriers.notes: Strong for drivers with prior incidents. Owns Drive Insurance for non-standard. Rideshare endorsements widely available.

carriers.name: GEICO
carriers.notes: Direct-only. Consistently low rates for clean records. Many affinity discounts (federal, military, alumni).

carriers.name: Allstate
carriers.notes: Owns National General (non-standard) and Esurance brand (retired). Drivewise + Milewise (pay-per-mile) widely available.

carriers.name: USAA
carriers.eligibility: Active duty, veterans, and their spouses/children. Verify before recommending.
carriers.notes: Consistently top-rated for claims satisfaction. Rates often beat competitors for eligible members.

carriers.name: Liberty Mutual
carriers.notes: Owns Safeco (independent-agent channel) and Liberty Mutual direct. Significant rate variance — always quote both.

carriers.name: Farmers
carriers.notes: Owns Bristol West and 21st Century (non-standard subsidiaries). Agent network strong in West/Midwest.

carriers.name: Nationwide
carriers.notes: SmartMiles is one of the cleanest pay-per-mile products. Vanishing-deductible is included, not paid.

carriers.name: American Family (AmFam)
carriers.notes: Strong loyalty/multi-line discounts. Owns Homesite and the General.

carriers.name: Travelers
carriers.notes: Independent-agent channel. Often competitive when bundled with home.

carriers.name: Erie Insurance
carriers.notes: Regional. Consistently top of J.D. Power claims and customer-satisfaction rankings. Rate Lock freezes premium until you change drivers/vehicles/address.

carriers.name: Auto-Owners
carriers.notes: Independent-agent only — must contact a local agent. Consistently ranked top-3 for claims satisfaction.

carriers.name: Amica Mutual
carriers.notes: Mutual; offers dividend policies that return 5-20% of premium. Consistently #1 or #2 in J.D. Power customer satisfaction.

carriers.name: The Hartford (AARP)
carriers.eligibility: AARP membership ($16/yr). Most competitive for drivers 50+.
carriers.notes: Aimed at 50+. Lifetime renewability rare in the market.

carriers.name: Safeco (Liberty Mutual)
carriers.notes: Independent-agent arm of Liberty Mutual. Often a different (sometimes lower) price than Liberty direct — quote both.

carriers.name: Mercury Insurance
carriers.notes: Often the price leader in California for clean records. Independent-agent channel.

carriers.name: AAA / CSAA / Auto Club
carriers.eligibility: AAA membership required. Each regional club (CSAA, ACA, ACE, etc.) is a separate insurer with separate rates.
carriers.notes: Pricing varies dramatically by club. CSAA (NorCal/NV/UT) and Auto Club Group (Midwest/SE) are the largest.

carriers.name: Root
carriers.notes: Quote requires a 2-3 week test drive via the app — rates are based almost entirely on driving behavior. Best for genuinely good drivers; declines many applicants.

carriers.name: Mile Auto
carriers.notes: Pay-per-mile, no GPS — you photograph your odometer monthly. Best for <8,000 mi/yr drivers.

carriers.name: Lemonade Car
carriers.notes: App-first, telematics-rated. EV/hybrid discounts. Bundles cleanly with Lemonade renters.

carriers.name: Metromile (Lemonade)
carriers.notes: Now Lemonade-owned but still a separate product. Clear winner for <6,000 mi/yr drivers in eligible states.

carriers.name: Direct Auto
carriers.notes: Non-standard market. Use for drivers with DUI, multiple at-faults, lapse in coverage, or SR-22.

carriers.name: The General
carriers.notes: Non-standard. Owned by American Family. Easy SR-22 filing.

carriers.name: Dairyland
carriers.notes: Non-standard. Owned by Sentry. Strong for SR-22/FR-44 and monoline (no home-bundle penalty).

carriers.name: National General (Allstate)
carriers.notes: Non-standard arm of Allstate. Often the path back to a standard carrier after 3 incident-free years.
